Crusoe’s $30 Billion Bet: AI Power Meets Wall Street Demand

Crusoe closed a $3B funding at $30B valuation alongside a $13B Jane Street cloud contract. The AI data center builder triples its worth in under a year while navigating execution risks and surging demand for power-hungry compute. This marks a pivotal moment for the sector.
